SELECT /* LGVPAY00035.retrievePayrollRunList */ pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pce.payroll_calculation_set_id , pacs.payroll_calculation_set_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') AS payroll_calc_period_value , pce.payroll_type_code AS payroll_type_code , cccm.common_code_name AS payroll_type_name , TO_CHAR(pce.basis_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS basis_date , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_pay_calc_set_target_per_n a WHERE a.payroll_calculation_set_id = pce.payroll_calculation_set_id) as employee_count , COUNT(*) AS total_count , sum(CASE WHEN pcee.error_flag = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS normal_count , sum(CASE WHEN pcee.error_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS error_count , TO_CHAR(MAX(pce.creation_date),'dd/mm/yyyy hh24:mi:ss') AS creation_date ,(SELECT um.user_name FROM lgcom_user_m um WHERE TO_CHAR(um.application_user_id) = pce.creation_user_id) AS created_by , NVL(pce.confirm_flag, 'N') AS confirm_flag , NVL(pce.retroactive_flag, 'N') AS retroactive_flag , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pce.retroactive_pay_start_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') AS retroactive_start_month , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pce.retroactive_payroll_end_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') AS retroactive_end_month , pce.adding_up_taxation_flag AS adding_up_taxation_flag , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pce.addup_taxation_start_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') AS addup_taxation_start_yyyymm
FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcpb , tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n pcee , tb_pay_calc_set_n pacs
WHERE pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue},'mm/yyyy'),'yyyymm') AND pcpb.Subsidiary_Code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN to_date(pcpb.start_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(pcpb.end_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd') AND pce.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pce.payroll_type_code = 'MTH_OS' /* LGVPAY00035 : MTH_OS 전용 */ AND cccm.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND pce.payroll_type_code = cccm.common_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pcee.payroll_calculation_exec_id(+) = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND pacs.payroll_calculation_set_id = pce.payroll_calculation_set_id
GROUP BY pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pce.payroll_calculation_set_id , pacs.payroll_calculation_set_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') , pce.payroll_type_code , cccm.common_code_name , TO_CHAR(pce.basis_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') , NVL(pce.confirm_flag, 'N') , NVL(pce.retroactive_flag, 'N') , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pce.retroactive_pay_start_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pce.retroactive_payroll_end_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') , pce.creation_user_id , pce.adding_up_taxation_flag , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pce.addup_taxation_start_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') ORDER BY 1 DESC

WITH temp AS ( /* payroll_calculation_exec_id 로 paymonth, paytype, calculation_set_id 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY00035.retrievePayrollCalculationExecConfirmData */ pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pce.payroll_type_code , pce.payroll_calculation_set_id , pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value /* pay month */ FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcpb WHERE pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pce.payroll_type_code = 'MTH_OS' AND pcpb.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN to_date(pcpb.start_yyyymmdd, 'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(pcpb.end_yyyymmdd, 'yyyymmdd') ) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN NVL(pce.confirm_flag, 'N') = 'Y' THEN pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id ELSE NULL END) AS payroll_calculation_exec_id FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcpb , tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , temp WHERE pcpb.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value = temp.payroll_calc_period_value AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN TO_DATE( pcpb.start_yyyymmdd,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(pcpb.end_yyyymmdd,'YYYYMMDD') AND pce.payroll_type_code = temp.payroll_type_code AND pce.payroll_type_code = 'MTH_OS' AND pce.payroll_calculation_set_id = temp.payroll_calculation_set_id
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAY00035.updateConfirmPayrollCalculationExec */ tb_pay_calc_exec_n SET confirm_flag = #{confirmFlag} /* 확정여부 */ WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여산출실행아이디 */ AND payroll_type_code = 'MTH_OS' /* LGVPAY00035 : MTH_OS 전용 */
